tests.name: ROS graph visible in same domain

defect.reproducer: Set turtlesim to ROS_DOMAIN_ID=16 and observer to ROS_DOMAIN_ID=17; /turtle1/pose is not received and timeout exits with code 124.
defect.root_cause: ROS 2 nodes in different ROS_DOMAIN_ID values do not discover each other.
defect.proof_after: Return observer and teleop to ROS_DOMAIN_ID=16; /turtle1/pose is received and timeout exits with code 0.
